meta.githubCommitMessage: Prepare executable hosted acceptance for the eight Forway workflows
Prepare executable hosted acceptance for the eight Forway workflows

steps.name: Run only the pinned hosted Forway packet

observation.success: B01–B07 desktop and B08 plain narrow all passed once, retry zero. Actual same-origin API retrieval of both owned public fixtures returned source-exact HTML and robots null/noindex respectively, with zero redirects. Browser extraction/12findings, inert hostile source, escaped artifact downloads/re-audit, separate evidence cohorts, full recovery from a UI-cleared empty workspace, rejection/cancel preservation, supported cancellation/newer-edit races and narrow keyboard/overflow workflows passed.
observation.servedSource: Nine independently fetched real static assets match checked source. All nine normal browser startup asset responses also match source in every case (72 per-case comparisons); no app or API response was mocked except B07's separately classified controlled timing.
observation.controlledTiming: B07 settled three controlled requests, including two cancellations and one successful retry. These are not additional live API/DNS checks; internal resolver/socket events and backend binary identity were not independently traced.
observation.limits: The previous 77 Node checks were not rerun. Browser-tool Node24.21 differs from production's configured Node26.x. Physical devices/touch/assistive technology, arbitrary-site import safety, indexing/rankings/representative AI visibility, analytics, providers, accounts/shared persistence and full-product acceptance remain open.

scenarios: B01 desktop entry, keyboard navigation and dialogs expose an empty honest workspace
B02 real public fixture import crosses the actual API and browser parser with twelve findings
B03 supplied hostile and structured HTML stays inert while literal facts become an editable draft
B04 real noindex header context survives edits and actual escaped HTML and metadata downloads
B05 supplied evidence retains original answers and isolated competitor-cohort denominators
B06 real workspace download and chooser restore partial rows and cohorts while rejection keeps current work
B07 controlled own-API delay preserves cancellation retry and a newer draft edit
B08 narrow viewport keeps audit content evidence and keyboard dialogs reachable without overflow

proofLimits: Eight authored browser cases exercise the public static workbench and actual same-origin API fetching only its own authored fixtures. B07 timing interception is separately classified; there are no accounts, persistence writes, third-party targets or model calls.

The deployment ID is an owning-workflow provider-metadata pin. Actual served asset byte hashes bind the frontend source, not the deployed backend binary; live API evidence is limited to the two own-fixture imports.
The only installed JavaScript tool is Playwright 1.61.1 in owned external runner storage. Chromium Linux system packages are installed on the disposable runner and are not independently uninstalled.

Direct child exit/close/EOF and original groups are checked. Same-UID Linux browser processes are additionally attributed by the unique owned binary/profile/cache path and kernel starttime; unreadable or uncertain attribution prevents owned-root deletion. This is not a host-wide process inventory.
Registry/browser downloads and allowed public hosted GETs are setup/acceptance network traffic, not a network sandbox. Userspace deadlines cannot interrupt blocked kernel filesystem calls.
